messages:
maria: reporting an onboarding demo failure: demo tenant created duplicate invoices during a 429/token-rotate window. short repro below.

maria: repro: 1) send two concurrent POST /invoices, 2) auth token rotates mid-flight, 3) server returns 429 on first retry, SDK retries without idempotency header, webhook sees two create events.

ankit: ouch. are the sample apps setting an Idempotency header?

maria: nope, the python sample didn't. node sample auto-adds one. logs: 
```
2026-03-22T17:12:03Z WARN  request 429 retrying
2026-03-22T17:12:03Z DEBUG attempt=1 idempotency=unset
```

josh: parity gap confirmed. node SDK has middleware that auto-sets `Idempotency-Key` on POSTs; python leaves it to caller. that's what caused the duplicate.

sophia: immediate fixes: (A) change python sampleapp to generate a stable idempotency key per logical op and attach header, (B) add jittered exponential backoff for 429s. simple backoff: `sleep = base * 2**attempt + random(0, jitter)`

maria: also noticed payloads include dynamic timestamps so server-side dedupe by body hash fails. need app-level key.

ankit: small suggestion: derive key from business identifiers when possible, otherwise uuid. snippet idea: 
```
const keySrc = `${invoice.customer_id}:${invoice.reference || nonce}`;
headers['X-Redwood-Idempotency'] = hex(sha256(keySrc));
```

josh: good. also add a demo webhook guard: track recent idempotency keys and ignore duplicates (return 200 no-op). cheap safety net for demos.

sophia: we should align SDK behavior: auto-add idempotency header for non-streaming POSTs unless user-provided. file an SDK parity issue.

maria: created issue https://redwood.internal/issue/SDK-1201 (SDK parity for idempotency). PR incoming to sampleapp to add header + doc snippet.

devex-bot: PR opened by maria: redwood/sampleapp#427 12 changed files.

ankit: can someone write an integration test that simulates token rotation + 429 to ensure single effective create? put it under devex/integration/flare.

josh: i'll add a test harness that asserts webhook called once per logical idempotency key. will mock token rotate and inject 429 on first attempt.

sophia: follow-ups: (1) merge sampleapp patch, (2) add python SDK parity middleware, (3) add demo webhook idempotency guard, (4) add integration test. target: EOD tomorrow.

maria: thanks. leaving a short note in the quickstart docs to highlight idempotency best-practices and show minimal examples for both derived and uuid keys.

ankit: :thumbsup: glad we caught this before a customer run.

josh: adding checklist to the PR for reviewers to verify test coverage and docs.

maria: closing loop: i'll post a small rollback plan in case demo still breaks after deploy.
